mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no as id, o.supplier_name as supplierName, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as startDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate, o.customer_amount as customerAmount, o.customer_total_amount as customerTotalAmount, o.payment_method as paymentMethod, o.contact as contact FROM `order` o WHERE o.supplier_display_id = #{supplierDisplayId} AND o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.order_no as id, cust.nickname as customerName, p.name as customerProduct, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as customerStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as customerEndDate, '月付' as customerPaymentMethod, 'System' as customerContact, supp.nickname as supplierName, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as supplierStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as supplierEndDate, '季付' as supplierPaymentMethod, 'System' as supplierContact FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `user` cust ON o.user_id = cust.id LEFT JOIN `product` p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `user` supp ON p.user_id = supp.id WHERE o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.order_no as id, o.product_id as productId, o.customer_product as customerProduct, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as startDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate, o.customer_product_quantity as customerProductQuantity, o.customer_amount as customerAmount, o.customer_total_amount as customerTotalAmount, o.payment_method as paymentMethod, o.remark as remark, o.contact as contact FROM `order` o WHERE o.user_display_id = #{userDisplayId} AND o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
